verdict.rationale: Vonage's own pricing page describes self-serve pay-as-you-go usage and a free allowance counted in minutes, which suggests minute-based usage pricing a founder could start on without sales. The evidence does not show an actual published per-participant-minute or bandwidth rate, so cost modeling cannot be confirmed. missing for 10: explicit published per-participant-minute or per-bandwidth rates, unit definition (participant-minute vs. session-minute), pricing for add-ons such as archiving or SIP, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales

citations.quote: Try it for free, pay as you go, and only then make a commitment
The first 100,000 free minutes are available to new Vonage Video API customers.
